children: China's annual GDP growth is likely to remain around 4.6% in 2027, broadly similar to 2026, according to UBS Securities' Yu Song in a research note. Policymakers appear to have preferred a more gradual slowdown in recent years and are likely to maintain support into early 2027, says the chief China economist. UBS expects Beijing to set its growth target again at 4.5-5%. The economist expects a smaller net export contribution to GDP as energy-transition demand eases and trade tensions weigh on exports. This is likely to increase the need to support domestic demand, UBS says. (tracy.qu@wsj.com)
